basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Southern California (USC) Viterbi PhD Fellowship in Computer Science
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Southern California (Viterbi School of Engineering - Thomas Lord Department of Computer Science)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Southern California University Park Campus (Los Angeles, California, USA)
degree_levels: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD in Computer Science)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to doctoral candidates in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, Natural Language Processing, Networked Systems, Cybersecurity, and Information Sciences Institute (ISI).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted PhD students receive guaranteed full financial support (~70 to 85 doctoral students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; typically 3 to 6 high-achieving Pakistani graduates admitted per academic year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Guaranteed 4 to 5-year full doctoral funding package (tuition remission + 12-month living stipend + health and dental insurance)

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (BS) or Master's degree (MS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related STEM discipline from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.80+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: USC Graduate School minimum GPA is 3.0/4.0; Viterbi CS doctoral admissions are highly competitive with average admitted GPA above 3.80.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial background in algorithms, computer systems, operating systems, linear algebra, calculus, and discrete mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in the final year of undergraduate or master's study can apply; degree completion required before August matriculation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Publications in top computing conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, OSDI, SIGCOMM, RSS, ICRA) or significant contributions to open-source software carry highest weight.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 100 (sub-scores 20+) or IELTS Academic min 7.0 (each section 6.5+). International Teaching Assistants must satisfy USC International Student English (ISE) examination standards.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; diversity in computing initiatives actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top applicants awarded prestigious USC Annenberg Fellowships, Viterbi Dean's Fellowships, or ISI Graduate Research Assistantships.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: External fellowship holders receive institutional top-up awards.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition waiver covering 100% of USC Viterbi graduate tuition up to 36 units per academic year (~USD 68,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: USC Graduate School application fee of USD 90 paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Paid from monthly living stipend; graduate apartments near University Park campus in Los Angeles (Lorenzo, Gateway, private housing north of campus) average USD 900 to 1,300/month for shared housing.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 12-month annual living stipend of USD 39,000 to USD 44,000 / year (~USD 3,250 to 3,666 / month; ~PKR 910,000 to 1,026,000 / month) provided via Viterbi Fellowships, Graduate Research Assistantships (RA), and Teaching Assistantships (TA).

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa fee (USD 185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (USD 350) paid to US government.

health_insurance.details: USC Student Health Insurance Plan (Aetna) and Student Health Center fee fully covered (~USD 5,200 / year value), including medical, dental, and vision benefits.

food_allowance.details: Food and living subsistence covered comfortably by the 12-month doctoral stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: High-performance GPU computing clusters, research lab hardware, and software licenses provided by Viterbi School and ISI.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental and advisor travel funds cover registration, airfare, and hotel costs (USD 1,500 to 3,000 per conference) for presenting accepted papers at leading conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: USC U-Pass provides unlimited free transit on LA Metro rail and bus network; free USC campus and housing shuttles around University Park.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Free LA Metro U-Pass and campus shuttles

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world-class private research university: University of Southern California (Los Angeles, CA, USA)
participating_institutions: Thomas Lord Department of Computer Science
USC Information Sciences Institute (ISI - Marina del Rey)

university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 20 global computer science program (CSRankings #14, US News CS #22, THE World #74); world pioneer in AI, robotics, computer vision, cybersecurity, and Internet architecture (ISI is the birthplace of DNS).
available_majors: PhD in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
PhD in Computer Science: Robotics & Autonomous Systems
PhD in Computer Science: Computer Vision & Graphics
PhD in Computer Science: Natural Language Processing & Knowledge Graphs
PhD in Computer Science: Networked Systems & Cybersecurity (ISI)
PhD in Computer Science: High-Performance Computing & Quantum Information
PhD in Computer Science: Theoretical Computer Science
PhD in Computer Science: Software Engineering & Systems
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS or MS in CS/STEM with 3.5+ GPA, 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, CV, and TOEFL 100+ or IELTS 7.0+. GRE is optional/waived.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI, robotics, and computer vision attract massive global application volumes; networked systems, cybersecurity at ISI, software engineering, and theory present slightly higher admission probability for candidates with matched skills.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check whether target faculty are based on the main campus or at ISI in Marina del Rey; cite specific projects and papers from target labs in your statement of purpose.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the USC CAS graduate portal, select Computer Science (PhD), designate faculty research groups, and upload required application materials.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Research faculty laboratories at USC CS, ISI, and ICT.
Step 2 (October - December): Create profile on the USC CAS graduate admissions portal.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and register 3 academic references.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Submit application and pay USD 90 application fee.
Step 5 (January - February): Faculty review applications and conduct technical video interviews.
Step 6 (February - March): Official PhD admission offer letters with 4-5 year guaranteed funding package released.
Step 7 (By 15 April): Confirm acceptance in the portal.
Step 8 (May - July): Receive Form I-20 and apply for US F-1 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: 100% of admitted PhD students are awarded 4 to 5-year full funding packages without a separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three academic recommendation letters submitted online via the USC CAS automated referee portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: 2-page essay discussing research experience, technical interests, faculty alignment, and doctoral aspirations.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into statement of purpose; focus on concrete research problems, past methodological contributions, and prospective research directions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, open-source repositories, engineering projects, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews (30-45 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty advisors evaluating research problem solving and mathematical intuition.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (100+) or IELTS Academic (7.0+). GRE is optional/waived.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scans uploaded for review; official transcripts required upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for non-English credentials.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the USC CAS portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF scans of official transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS transcripts; official HEC attestation required only upon matriculation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 2-page statement of purpose articulating research questions, past projects, technical methodology, and why USC CS faculty are an ideal fit.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on research depth and technical contributions rather than generic personal background.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Three confidential recommendation letters from professors or research scientists familiar with your creative research capacity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure professors submit from verified university domain email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive CV detailing academic history, research projects, technical skills, publications, and GitHub links.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly differentiate peer-reviewed publications, preprints, and coursework projects.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT (code 4852) or IELTS Academic score report taken within past 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Aim for TOEFL 105+ or IELTS 7.5+ to satisfy TA spoken English standards.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF copies of published papers or arXiv preprints demonstrating research depth.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Submitting first-author papers at top conferences significantly boosts admission probability.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions offered for Fall semester only. Hard deadline is December 15.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (GPA, difficulty of computer science coursework, mathematical foundations)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 5% (academic service, leadership, contributions to open-source computing)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (published research, statement of purpose, technical sophistication, code samples)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (industry research experience or software engineering roles)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (clarity of research goals and alignment with faculty mentors)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (credibility of referees and their specific evaluations of research aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (alignment with faculty grants and technical performance in video interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Thomas Lord CS Doctoral Admissions Committee, ISI research directors, and faculty lab PIs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty-led holistic review: Candidate applications are evaluated by research area sub-committees (AI, Systems, ISI), followed by faculty interviews and appointment to research assistantships.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 3,500+ applicants for USC CS PhD program
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~70 to 85 funded PhD offers accepted annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~4% to 5% admit rate for PhD in Computer Science
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% to 4% among applicants from premier Pakistani universities
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/SE with top standing, 1-2 research papers at tier-1 international conferences (CVPR, NeurIPS, ACL, ICRA), outstanding faculty recommendation letters.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of LUMS, NUST, FAST-NUCES, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: United States, China, India, South Korea, Canada, Pakistan, Iran

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging large sums claiming guaranteed admission or funding at USC. Admissions decisions are made exclusively by USC faculty.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay the USD 90 application fee only through the official USC CAS portal. Never wire money to intermediaries.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: USC strictly forbids the use of admissions agents. Plagiarized statements of purpose result in immediate disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa and SEVIS I-901 fees: USD 535 (~PKR 150,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Los Angeles: ~PKR 350,000 to 500,000.
Initial apartment security deposit and living costs: ~USD 1,500 (~PKR 420,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE General Test is mandatory. (FACT: The GRE is optional/waived for Computer Science PhD applicants).
CLAIM: Only US citizens receive tuition coverage. (FACT: 100% of admitted PhD students, domestic and international, receive identical full funding packages).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online forums report that MS students receive automatic funding. At USC, guaranteed multi-year funding packages are reserved for PhD students; MS degrees are largely self-funded.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher in all graduate coursework with satisfactory research progress.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and academic residency on the University Park campus or ISI.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the doctoral program committee and faculty advisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Graduate research and teaching assistantships are capped at 20 hours per week during academic semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for US F-1 OPT with 3-year STEM extension and employer-sponsored permanent residence pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; past disbursements are not subject to clawback.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Fellowships cannot be transferred to other universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing research areas or advisors requires approval from the Department Chair and finding a faculty member with research funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 4-5 years; extensions into Year 6 are supported via faculty advisor research grants.
